notes: Library view on /books: a cover grid on a computer and rows on a phone, a segmented status filter with counts, 'Search books' at the top, a sort menu, book-shaped loading placeholders and an empty shelf with Add book. The test-writer's spec sorts by title, so the old order question is settled. Baselines that end on /books were regenerated. On a phone the status filter is a 2x2 grid of 44 px segments with no sideways scroll; on a computer the filter track, Sort, search input and button are all 36 px tall. Phone overflow fix: title has [overflow-wrap:anywhere] (break-words removed from the title because Tailwind's break-words overrides it), author is truncate, and the row li has min-w-0 so the single-column grid track cannot grow past the viewport. The verifier FAILED the version without min-w-0 (a long spaced author gave scrollWidth 722 at 390 px). With min-w-0 the verifier PASSED (2026-11-17): scrollWidth 390 = innerWidth with a long unbroken title and a long spaced author, and no overflow at 320/375/414/768/1024. Follow-ups accepted by the owner (2026-11-18), not fixed in this feature: (1) the /books filter row wraps at 1024 px; (2) StatusTabs segments are 28 px tall from 640 to 1023 px; (3) the grid placeholder cover repeats and cuts the title; (4) docs/design/M9.md still describes a scrolling filter.
